{{Quote|I swear this sacred oath that I shall render unconditional obedience to Emperor Palpatine, to exercise every power in service to the Galactic Empire, and shall, whensoever I am asked, be prepared, as a loyal servant, to surrender my life for this oath.|Oath of Obedience|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "[[Riot stormtrooper/Legends|Riot Trooper]]" databank entry}}</ref>}}
The '''Oath of Obedience''' was a vow made,<ref name="TFUII" /> for some [[Time/Legends|time]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="date">According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occur in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the tie-in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic]], the oath must have been in use during that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> by [[Riot stormtrooper/Legends|riot troopers]] who were graduating from the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy|Imperial Academy]] of [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. The oath consisted of a pledge to give complete allegiance to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], even to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oath of Obedience was mentioned in the "Riot Trooper" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
